# Kartel — the family coat of arms

> kartel.org.uk is the home of the coat of arms of the Kartel family: a griffin, crossed keys, coronet, swords, fleur-de-lis and wings, with the Latin motto "Virtus et Potestas" (Strength and Power). Based in London, United Kingdom. Bilingual: English and Russian.

## The coat of arms

- **Griffin** — strength, protection and foresight; the lion and the eagle in one form.
- **Staff** — service, not dominion: spiritual authority as responsibility.
- **Crossed keys** — knowledge and the union of reason and faith; every person holds the keys to their own destiny.
- **Wings and mantling** — protection, freedom of spirit, loyalty to duty.
- **Coronet and fleur-de-lis** — authority granted by merit, not by blood; purity of intention.
- **Swords** — readiness to stand between danger and what is dear.
- **Motto** — "Virtus et Potestas": strength is the ability to go all the way; power is the measure of maturity.
- **Colours** — gold and sable, silver and gules.

## Key facts

- **Family name**: Kartel (Картель)
- **Motto**: Virtus et Potestas (Strength and Power / Сила и Власть)
- **Location**: London, United Kingdom
- **Languages**: English, Russian
- **Domain**: kartel.org.uk
